name: Campos Novos (Brazil)
description: Horizontal triband of blue, white and blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms under a yellow star.
history: Campos Novos is a municipality in the state of Santa Catarina, Brazil. Flags of the World records that the flag and arms were prescribed by Municipal Law No. 229 of 1959: blue for the sky and water, white for peace, and the arms show the sources of income — the Brazilian pine, wheat, horses, cattle and mechanised farming.

features.role: municipal arms with a green shield bearing a horse, cattle, an araucaria pine, wheat and a tractor, reading CAMPOS NOVOS
